nodes.title: Refuse a date value naming no existing day
nodes.summary: The date branch of parseAttributeValue now refuses a well-shaped value that names no calendar day (2024-02-30, 2023-02-29, 2024-04-31), accepts 2024-02-29, and names the value and its value type in the refusal's details.

nodes.title: Expanded links score from the matched node they were reached from
nodes.summary: Search expansion now traverses from each matched node separately, so every expanded link scores 0.5 raised to its hop times the score of the matched node it was reached from, and a link reached from several matched nodes is listed once.

nodes.title: Version 4 extraction prompt no longer asks for the basis received
nodes.summary: The version 4 directive still resolves a relative date against the document date, else against the date portion of received_at, and no longer tells the model to state the basis received.

nodes.title: Proof that a date value naming no existing day is refused
nodes.summary: Four REST-level tests and two table-driven parser tests hold that a date value naming no existing day is refused with VALIDATION_INVALID_FORMAT as an HTTP 200 envelope and records no node attribute, while 2024-02-29 is accepted.

nodes.title: Proof for expanded links scoring from the matched node they were reached from
nodes.summary: Tests that a search expanded to depth 3 scores each expanded link 0.5 raised to its hop times the score of the matched node it was reached from, numbers its hop by path length, and answers every item with the search-item attributes.

nodes.title: Proof that the version 4 extraction prompt no longer asks for the basis received
nodes.summary: Four tests over the text version 4 appends to the version 3 system prompt hold the reception fallback behind the document date, the absence of any basis on that fallback, the absence of the basis received, and the surviving instruction never to invent a date.

nodes.title: Review of the drift-corrections initiative
nodes.summary: The conformance, coverage, standard and certification judgments over the seven files the three drift-corrections tasks wrote, with the run of the registry's steps over the change.
unproven: The system prompt of version 4 contains no instruction to state the basis received on a proposal.
